summary: Fang Holdings filed a Form 6-K on May 15, 2026, announcing board changes. Independent director Howard Huyue Zhang resigned for personal reasons effective May 13, 2026, with no disagreement with the company. Shaohua Zhang was appointed as audit committee chair effective May 14, 2026. The board retains five directors, including three independents. This is a routine governance adjustment with no forced departure or event-driven implications. No deal terms, prices, or strategic actions are involved. As a foreign private issuer, this Form 6-K functions like a U.S. 8-K for material events. What to watch: any further board changes or strategic shifts; no risk-arb angle.
